verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or community evidence about Unreal Insights, stat/profiling commands, GPU profiling, or data-oriented paths like Mass Entity/ECS, job systems, or GPU instancing — only generic command-line-argument docs mentioning 'testing and optimizing' in passing. Profiling and data-oriented scaling are core, expected capabilities for a AAA game engine, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack demonstrates a real profiler or ECS/jobs/instancing systems.
